title: Melchior de Sabran to Claude Bouthillier, Genoa 1633, BnF fr. 4134 (Sabran's letter-book), nine leaves in Lasry's Sabran key (catalogue 310, part)

steps.what: Outside input, issue #56 (Harumi-Matsuba): AI transcription of the cipher passages of nine fr. 4134 leaves (891 signs) by Claude Opus 5.5, disagreements judged by Codex and Claude Sonnet over seven rounds (16 of 60 corrections reverted on a two-way re-judging).

Outside input, issue #56: Lasry's 2022 key applied to the transcription; 879/891 signs valued; words on every leaf (Savone, munitionnaire, prisonniers, donner la place, de l'intelligence dans cet estat), long stretches without words on ff. 50v, 54r, 57r.

Outside input, issue #56: 1000 shuffled keys scored on French-likeness, 0 at or above the real key on every leaf; independent Codex transcription (three runs) 92.4-92.7% sign agreement; calibration on Baluze 155 f. 79 against Lasry's decipherment 92.0% of letters.

Re-measured here (measure.py): fr-1600-letters LM beats all 1000 shuffled letter keys on every leaf; 666/896 decoded letters (74.3%) covered by corpus words of 3+ letters against 27.0% median for shuffled keys; calibration recomputed 551/599 (final) and 540/599 (first transcription).

Gallica (BnF IIIF) images of f. 66r and f. 66v compared sign by sign with the contributed transcription: f. 66v 59/59, f. 66r 113/116 checked signs agree; a duplicated '8 nt' across c139_23/23b and a wrong AI-agreed correction z->lh (c139_23c, secre[t]) found.

No DECODE record for fr. 4134 or fr. 4135; Tomokiyo louisxiii.htm/GL.htm list the passages as undeciphered and credit Lasry with finding that the key applies; Lasry to be asked whether he holds readings.

outcome.method_basis: George Lasry's 2022 key 'BNF Francais 4134', named for these letters on Tomokiyo's Cryptiana, applied by Harumi-Matsuba to an AI transcription of nine leaves; measured here at 98.7% of signs valued and 74.3% of decoded letters in words.
outcome.fraction_read_source: measure.py over contributed/data/transcription.tsv: 879 of 891 signs have a key value; fraction_coherent = 666/896 decoded letters covered by fr-henri4 corpus words of 3+ letters (an upper bound: shuffled keys reach 0.27)
outcome.notes: Contributed AI-only reading; no person has checked the transcription. Spot-check here on f. 66r-v 172/175 signs agree. Status: in progress.

credits.note: AI transcription and reading of the cipher passages of nine fr. 4134 leaves with Lasry's key, controls and calibration (Claude, Codex, Sonnet; no human check)
key 'BNF Francais 4134' (25 May 2022) reconstructed by Lasry; also his decipherment of Baluze 155 f. 79, used for the calibration
published Lasry's key on GL.htm and listed the fr. 4134 and fr. 4135 cipher passages on louisxiii.htm

prior.where: Not published. Tomokiyo (louisxiii.htm, GL.htm) lists these passages as undeciphered and reports that George Lasry found his key applies to them, so Lasry may hold unpublished readings; to be asked. The contributor's prior-work check found nothing in print or online.

human: Contributed result: Harumi-Matsuba's own AI pipeline produced the transcription and reading (a person chose the target and decided to publish). Project-level: Daniel Bourdeau set up Claude Code and posed the integration task; the project re-measured and spot-checked only.
